ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 85% high-intensity (white) and 15% low-intensity (black/dark gray) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominant high-intensity white central field; contiguous low-intensity black border spanning the entire trailing edge and central peduncle attachment; numerous isolated low-intensity circular pixel clusters (dark spots) scattered across the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65-75 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-15 pixels occurring along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge sweep from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12 localized, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (light on white and light on dark) consistent with surface scarring patterns on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the right lobe upper quadrant and central left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, yellowish-brown pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
